description: Public-suffix-list family (tld-plus-one, is-public-suffix, affiliation). A family verb: name the sub-verb as "sub" alongside the input. Sub-verbs: tldPlusOne, isPublicSuffix, affiliation.. Answers without an API key. Example call: {"skill":"psl","sub":"tldPlusOne","input":"a.b.example.co.uk"}

input.description: The indicator to look up: a domain, an IP address, an ASN or a file hash. The example passes a.b.example.co.uk.

sub.description: Which sub-verb of this family to run. The example runs "tldPlusOne".

name: whisper_psl

outputSchema.description: A tabular graph answer: the column names, the rows keyed by them, and the cost.

columns.description: The column names, in order. Every row object has exactly these keys, so this is the row shape and reading it is cheaper than inspecting a row.

rows.description: The answers, one object per row, keyed by the column names above. An empty array means the question was understood and nothing matched, which is an answer and not a failure.

title: psl
